Chezmoi dotfiles: source `~/.local/share/chezmoi/`, target `~/`; apply via `chezmoi apply` (copies, not symlinks). Files in `~/` managed by chezmoi should NEVER be edited directly. Always edit source or use `chezmoi edit`.
chezmoi managed | grep <filename>
chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc
chezmoi add ~/.newfile
git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push
Store scripts in `~/.local/bin/`; code/chmod/add commands as provided. Ensure PATH export. Scripts should NOT have `.sh` extension. Bash template/path and `set -euo pipefail` apply. `{{ }}` files MUST have `.tmpl`.
⚠️ NEVER run bare cass — it launches an interactive TUI. Always use --robot or --json.
Before solving, search cass. Use provided cass commands/options; stdout=data, stderr=diagnostics, exit 0=success.
